lore.title: LOST TAPE #{n}
lore.fragments: Day 1. I filmed the office door. It wasn't there this morning.
The lights never go out. I counted: they hum at 100 hertz. All of them. Everywhere.
I crossed my own footprints. I had never been here.
The carpet is damp. It smells like wet cardboard and something older.
Someone is walking two corridors away. When I stop, they stop.
I left a chair in the middle of the room. When I came back, it was against the wall.
The battery lasts longer if I film in the dark. I don't know if that's good news.
Some doors lead elsewhere. None of them lead outside.
The picture skips when I get close to the stains on the walls. So does the sound.
I found another camera. The tape inside is me. Filmed from behind.
Further down, the ceiling tiles fall. Above them there is nothing. Not darkness: nothing.
The radio always plays the same note. I follow it. It backs away.
I rewound too far. Yesterday's corridor came back, with me in it.
If you find these tapes: don't follow the light. Follow the noise.
I'm not afraid of the dark anymore. I'm afraid of what turns the lights off.
Last tape. I'm going through the half-open door. Someone is holding the handle.
lore.end: No more tapes: the story ends here. Or someone stopped filming.
